title: Fire truck with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x='18' y='14' width='54' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9d6e3'/>
  <rect x='18' y='20' width='54' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9d6e3'/>
  <rect x='22' y='12' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <rect x='36' y='12' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <rect x='50' y='12' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <rect x='64' y='12' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='10' y='40' width='62' height='34' rx='5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <rect x='12' y='43' width='58' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f47a80'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='62' y='30' width='28' height='44' rx='6' fill='#f2545b'/>
  <rect x='64' y='32' width='24' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ff8f95'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='66' y='40' width='20' height='15' rx='3' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <rect x='68' y='42' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d8f8ff'/>
  <!-- face on the cab side (front of truck) -->
  <!-- actually face on body front panel -->
  <rect x='12' y='44' width='24' height='20' rx='4' fill='#ff9a6b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a20'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a20'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='51' r='1.2' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='51' r='1.2' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M18 58 Q25 64 33 58' stroke='#3a2a20' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffbe8f'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffbe8f'/>
  <!-- light bar -->
  <rect x='68' y='26' width='16' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#3d7bff'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <rect x='40' y='50' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='40' y='60' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='10' fill='#2b2f3a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='4.5' fill='#aeb8c6'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='10' fill='#2b2f3a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='4.5' fill='#aeb8c6'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='8' y='74' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9d6e3'/>
</svg>
